title: Singular negatives: tämä, tuo, se ei ole…
summary: Build singular demonstrative statements with ei ole.
objectives: Place ei ole after a singular demonstrative subject.
Interpret and produce complete negative statements.

sections.title: See the pattern
paragraphs: A singular demonstrative subject uses ei ole for a negative present-tense olla statement.
The negative verb is ei and the main verb appears as ole.

sections.title: Use one clear decision
paragraphs: Keep both words: tämä kirja ei ole, tuo auto ei ole, se talo ei ole.
Reference choice is supplied whenever the target is the negative construction.

examples.english: The previously identified book is not here.

commonMistakes: Do not use eivät with a singular demonstrative subject.
Do not keep affirmative on after ei.
